checks.name: xcode-select
checks.detail: active developer directory is the Command Line Tools (/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools); there is no full Xcode
checks.fix: install Xcode (docs/mobile/ios-build-host.md step 2), then: sudo xcode-select -s /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer

checks.name: xcodebuild
checks.detail: xcodebuild is not usable: xcode-select: error: tool 'xcodebuild' requires Xcode, but active developer directory '/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools' is a command line tools instance
checks.fix: select a full Xcode with xcode-select -s

checks.name: xcode-license-first-launch
checks.detail: cannot be checked without a working Xcode
checks.fix: after installing Xcode: sudo xcodebuild -license accept && sudo xcodebuild -runFirstLaunch

checks.name: cocoapods
checks.fix: install with Homebrew (brew install cocoapods) inside the dedicated build user; see docs/mobile/ios-build-host.md step 5

checks.name: build-host-policy
checks.detail: not declared as a dedicated build user (user 'elaf'; NUZM_BUILD_ENV and NUZM_BUILD_USER are not set to match). AI-generated code must never build as the owner's normal user
checks.fix: create a dedicated standard macOS user, log in as it, export NUZM_BUILD_ENV=disposable NUZM_BUILD_USER=<that user> (docs/mobile/ios-build-host.md step 1)
